export.title: Export & Sampling
export.description: Forward unified logs to Syslog / Kafka / Webhook (SIEM) and choose full, sampled or errors-only based on capacity policy.

diskNote.degraded: the limit has been exceeded repeatedly, so the system automatically switched to errors-only sampling to protect the disk (user policy {policy}); it recovers automatically once usage stays below 85% (this start: {time}).
diskNote.degradedNoTime: the limit has been exceeded repeatedly, so the system automatically switched to errors-only sampling to protect the disk (user policy {policy}); it recovers automatically once usage stays below 85%.
diskNote.over90: usage is above 90%, so it will switch to errors-only after 3 consecutive checks; you can also switch manually now and clean up archives.
diskNote.over85: usage is above 85%, please watch capacity; staying above 90% triggers automatic degradation.
diskNote.normal: capacity is normal and automatic degradation is not triggered.

samplingCard.title: Sampling & capacity
samplingCard.hint: Sampling applies to both ClickHouse ingestion and all export channels; 85% disk usage raises a warning, 90% degrades to errors-only automatically, and it restores below 85%. Evaluate audit/compliance retention requirements before changing this in production.
samplingCard.footer: Vector retries failed exports internally and never blocks ClickHouse ingestion
